title: Zero locus of a section of a locally constant sheaf
statement: Let T be a topological space and F a locally constant sheaf of abelian groups [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] on T, meaning that every point has an open neighbourhood on which F is isomorphic to a constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. For s in Gamma(T,F) (sections and germs as for sheaves on a topological space [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image]), let Z(s) be the set of points at which the germ of s is zero. Then Z(s) is both open and closed in T.
